methods.label: Interpret the interquartile range
methods.explanation: The interquartile range is the difference between the third quartile and the first quartile. It reflects the range of the middle 50% of the data. A larger interquartile range indicates greater spread.
methods.levelReason: This is a direct Grade 8 interpretation of the interquartile range.
